usedFor: PostFast schedules social posts, with “Create Post” saving a draft or scheduling and “Reply to Comment” answering comments.

bestTemplate.name: “New Video Uploaded” in YouTube, then “Create Post” in PostFast
bestTemplate.why: A new video can become a scheduled or draft post.

watchOut: “Reply to Comment” answers people outside the business, so it waits in Needs you for approval first.
